release_notes: Feature release. Domains: Keitaro-style panel — dedicated domain groups, per-domain admin access (deny = panel/API answer 404 on that host while tracking keeps serving), Cloudflare proxy flag (edge SSL, Certbot queue skipped), registrar/DNS metadata, manual status (Disabled = whole host 404), bulk add with URL cleanup and an Add-more workflow; schema v23 seeds groups from offer_groups under the same ids and rebuilds the FK. Campaign control: RedTrack-style play/pause — internal campaigns stop serving immediately (503), and real Facebook ads / ad sets / campaigns pause or activate right from the table and report rows via the Meta Marketing API, the owning account resolved through cost records. Streams: per-stream Collect clicks (schema v24) — fallback and white-page streams serve their destination without writing a click row, consistently across index.php, click.php and the Click API. New Ads Manager browser extension: profit/ROI/CPA pills inside Facebook Ads Manager plus a per-entity drill-down (daily history, landings & offers, Pixel/CAPI delivery accuracy) with an auto-provisioned read key from Integrations. Dashboard: settings and StatCards redesigned — 27 cards wired to real aggregated metrics (cost is no longer hard-coded to zero), presets, finance masking extended to CPL/CPS/EPV. Reports now also return raw dim_ids next to display names. Tables: high-density sticky-header Campaigns/Landers/Offers with zebra striping, single-line campaign rows, row kebab menus (incl. copy link and duplicate) and pagination; every monetary metric unified to $0.00 including CSV export. Device taxonomy (Desktop/Mobile/Tablet) shared by the tracker, Click API and reports; CPV metric. Theming: hardcoded Tailwind grays/blues purged panel-wide, ClickDetailsModal white-on-white fixed. Schema v25 adds campaigns.state — the column never existed and live testing surfaced it. Docs refreshed, READMEs halved (embedded version archive moved to CHANGELOG).
